items.example: When she was fifteen she went to university.
At university she met her future husband, Obi.
Samiya and Obi started a company together.
Their apps made a lot of money.
She was really good at maths and computer games.
In her childhood Samiya was very shy.
She studied information technology for four years.
She was born in a small village near Lagos.
Her father worked as a taxi driver.
He gradually stopped playing football at work.
In her fourth year at university she met Obi.
Read the two life stories and put the sentences in order.
The two women are time twins — they are the same age and they met at fifteen.
She regrets not going to art college.
